عُلَاثَةٌ Clarified butter, (S, O, K, TA,) or oliveoil, (TA,) and [the preparation of curd called] أَقِط, mixed together: (S, O, K, TA:) and any
two things mixed together: (S, O, K:) pl. [or rather coll. gen. n.] ↓ عُلَاثٌ . (O.) See also عَلْثٌ. ―
-b2- Also A man who collects from various places. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
